name: Ophidian Eye
oracle_text:
Flash (You may cast this spell any time you could cast an instant.)
Enchant creature
Whenever enchanted creature deals damage to an opponent, you may draw a card.
blocked_sentences: Whenever enchanted creature deals damage to an opponent, you may draw a card.

needs.what: a trigger event fired whenever a permanent deals damage of any kind -- combat or noncombat -- to a player, with the damaging permanent as the subject (so an Aura's `filter: {"attached": true}` can scope it to the enchanted creature) and the damaged player available to a `defending` clause so "to an opponent" can be said
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `deals_combat_damage_to_player` is the near miss and is combat-only by construction: EventType.COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER is fired only on the combat path, so a pinger, a Fireball, a fight or any triggered burn under this Aura draws nothing -- and this card is played precisely for the noncombat half (it is Curiosity with flash, the Niv-Mizzet piece), so the substitution is a different card rather than a weaker one. `dealt_damage` is the other candidate and is the wrong half of the right event: EventType.DAMAGE_DEALT does carry damage to a player, but `triggers._matches` rejects it with `event.data.get("to") != "permanent"`, and its OBJECT_SUBJECT_TRIGGERS entry makes the subject the creature that was *hurt* rather than the one that dealt it, so it can neither see damage aimed at a player nor identify the enchanted creature as the dealer. `life_lost` reaches the loss but not the dealer: its subject is a player, so nothing ties the loss back to the enchanted creature, and it fires for discards, taxes and Phyrexian mana as readily as for damage while an infect hit deals damage and fires it not at all.
